description: Current Arbitrum One gas conditions: block number, base fee, gas price and priority fee in gwei, and the estimated cost in ETH and USD of a native transfer and an ERC-20 transfer (Chainlink ETH/USD); plus how the current price ranks against our own samples every 10 minutes over the last 7 days, and the usually cheapest UTC hour. Costs $0.005 USDC on Base via x402.
